tier.title: Choose your role
tier.peerDesc: For users who just want to chat — anyone with real experience can join and share industry insights, study and career stories.
tier.peerReqs: Requires: identity + education + work experience review
tier.mentorDesc: For users seeking professional help — structured career planning, guidance and coaching services.
tier.mentorReqs: Requires: all Peer materials + coaching certificates + a ~20-min 1v1 interview after document approval

header.description: Complete your profile to start taking bookings. Education and work proof are required records for the platform and are visible only to admins; you can apply for Verified status later.

basic.headline: One-line headline
basic.headlinePlaceholder: e.g. Former ByteDance product director | Helping you transition into tech
basic.bioPlaceholder: Your background, your coaching style, and what you can help students solve…
basic.companies: Past companies (press Enter to add more)
basic.schoolsPlaceholder: e.g. Beijing Normal University, Central Academy of Fine Arts
basic.customTopicsPlaceholder: Custom tag, press Enter to add
basic.tagInputPlaceholder: Type and press Enter to add

meeting.label: Meeting link
meeting.placeholder: Your personal Feishu / Tencent Meeting / Zoom room link
meeting.hint: Students can only see this link after you confirm a booking.

docs.educationHint: Diploma / degree certificate / enrollment proof (PDF/JPG/PNG, ≤10MB). Required, at least 1 file.
docs.workHint: Employment certificate / termination letter / labor contract / work badge, etc. Required, at least 1 file.
docs.otherHint: Awards, portfolio, case studies — help students get to know you
docs.certHint: ICF / ACC / PCC, GCDF, career planner, counselor certificates, etc. — at least 1. After document approval, the platform will schedule a ~20-min 1v1 interview.

errors.documentsRequired: Education and work proof are required. Please upload at least one of each.
errors.priceRequired: Enter at least one of the single-session price or the 5-session package price
errors.mentorCertsRequired: Applying as a Coach requires at least 1 professional coaching credential
